items.headline: Carrick demands response after humiliating Hull defeat
items.summary: Michael Carrick wants immediate improvement from Manchester United against Ipswich after opening-day 2-0 loss to newly-promoted Hull City at home.

items.headline: Mount returns to squad; Diallo sidelined longer
items.summary: Mason Mount back in contention for Ipswich game after training with squad; Amad Diallo ruled out and will be absent for longer period.

items.headline: Carlos Baleba completes Manchester United transfer
items.summary: Midfielder Carlos Baleba has signed for Manchester United from Brighton but remains weeks away from debut due to ankle injury.
